thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api queue p99 > 8s for > 3m; GPU pools at 100% and autoscaler failing to allocate new nodes (quota_error). Correlation: sudden traffic spike from an external campaign.

sara-oncall: Ack. I'm paging SRE. Checking autoscaler logs now.

lena: I'm on it. Seeing a stream of CreateNode failures with `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: quota exceeded` across 2 regions.

mike: Any customer-facing impact yet? We should consider fallback routing to smaller models.

sara-oncall: p95 ~ 420ms but p99 jumped to 9-12s and a few 504s. Some tenants reporting timeouts. CS notified.

ashok: Can we short-circuit heavy batch work? Saw a spike in batch sizes from a partner job.

lena: Confirmed. Top 3 tenants account for ~65% of recent queue growth. Autoscaler attempted 5x launches, cloud API returned quota errors.

ops-runbooks: Runbook link: https://intra/runbooks/hosted-queue-capacity

sara-oncall: Mitigation plan (short):
- throttle ephemeral tenants by enabling quick rate limit patch
- route non-critical traffic to r1-small models
- request emergency quota bump with cloud ops
- manual warm pool allocation if quota granted

mike: Applying rate-limit patch now: `curl -X POST https://internal/api/limits/patch -d '{"path":"/models/*/rate_limit","value": "75%"}'` (will push in 30s)

ashok: Pushed a temporary routing rule to prefer `r1-small` for non-authenticated requests. Watching queue.

lena: Added a guard to reject excessive batch sizes > 128 to avoid large memory pressure.

incident-bot: pagerduty: Severity set to P1. Oncall: sara-oncall. Escalation: lena -> infra lead.

pagerduty: Noted. Paging infra lead.

sara-oncall: CS update: "We're investigating increased latency; some requests may timeout. Mitigations in flight." Posting to affected tenants.

mike: After rate limit + small-model routing, incoming queue dropped ~40% in 2m. p99 trending down to ~4s but still noisy.

lena: Cloud quota team responding. They need approval note; contacting finance for emergency approval for temporary quota increase.

ashok: If quota bump doesn't land, we should cut a soft-failure path for large inference jobs and return 429 with Retry-After for non-urgent workloads.

sara-oncall: Agree. Preparing message for ops to flip soft-fail. Anyone want to own the manual pool warm if quota approved?

mike: I can take manual warm and watch instance creation logs. `gcloud compute instances create --zone=... --count=6 --labels=warm-pool`

lena: Handing off for sustained mitigation to night oncall. I'll remain on call for infra escalation. Handoff notes in thread. Switching channel to #incidents-bridges for live bridge.

sara-oncall: Thanks team — moving to bridge and updating status page. Leaving core mitigation to lena/mike/ashok.

mike: On bridge. Monitoring until p99 < 2s or quota issue resolved.

ashok: Preparing 429 soft-fail toggle: `/svc/hosted-api/feature toggle soft_fail_large_jobs true`

incident-bot: Incident log created: INC-2026-045 (hosted-api-slot-starvation). Add postmortem label once resolved.

sara-oncall: Last note before handoff: customers impacted: several mid-market tenants saw >10% request failure; flagged high-touch CS follow-up.

lena: Leaving thread for handoff; will rejoin if quota bump fails or OOMs reappear.
